The player must first locate a dispenser (which contains flint and steel or torches as loot), then navigate through areas marked by white stained glass panes and a birch trapdoor (serving as pathway gates/landmarks), ultimately reaching a dark cave that needs to be lit up. The dispenser provides the lighting tool, the glass pane and trapdoor serve as navigational waypoints that guide the player toward the cave, creating a logical progression from resource acquisition to environment modification.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The dispenser is at spawn-relative (0, 1, 3). max_distance reduced to 5 (from 16) to prevent auto-completion at spawn — the player must walk forward a few steps to get within 5 blocks and face the dispenser. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The white stained glass panes are at z=7 and z=9 on both corridor walls. Target is the center of the first pair at (0, 1, 7). max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable corridor distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the glass panes. The player must progress past the dispenser to be facing this direction.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The birch trapdoor is at spawn-relative (0, 0, 13) at the end of the corridor, marking the cave entrance. max_distance=8 ensures the player has progressed well past the glass pane section (z=7-9) before this triggers. facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking toward/down at the trapdoor.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block', object='torch') because lighting up a cave requires placing torch blocks inside it. Changed from 'wall_torch' to 'torch' per CommonSenseAgent feedback — when a player descends the ladder and reaches the cave floor (y=-6), the most natural action is to place torches on the floor, which creates 'torch' blocks (not 'wall_torch'). The generous box from (-3,-7,13) to (3,-1,20) encompasses the entire cave interior and shaft area. min_count=1 means at least one torch must be placed to consider the cave 'lit up'.

scene_description: A stone brick corridor leading from spawn to a dark underground cave. The corridor contains: (1) a dispenser with 8 torches near the entrance, (2) white stained glass panes decorating the walls in the middle section, (3) a birch trapdoor marking the cave entrance at the end, and (4) a dark enclosed cave accessible via ladder below the trapdoor. The player must find the dispenser, take torches, navigate through the glass-pane corridor, find the trapdoor, descend into the cave, and place torches to light it up.
task_text: Explore the dungeon corridor: find the dispenser and take the torches inside, navigate through the corridor with white glass pane decorations, locate the birch trapdoor at the end, then descend into the dark cave below and light it up by placing torches.
design_notes: Linear corridor layout: spawn → dispenser (z=3) → glass panes (z=7,9) → birch trapdoor (z=13) → ladder shaft (z=14, y=-1 to -5) → dark cave (z=15-19, y=-6 to -2). No /give command — player must get torches from dispenser. Stone fill extended to z=13 to provide ladder backing. Cave is fully enclosed in stone with no light sources. Ladder facing=south attaches to solid stone at z=13.
